items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Then you did some Luis Gasca session, and then a Nat Adderley, Calling Out Loud, and then Walter Wanderley.

ctx.x: LSD, yeah. It was during that time. It thought it was such a pity. He was so young, Gary McFarland. Do you see where Curtis Fuller was a part of that date?
No, but it might be a different session, because of the chronology. Then you did some Luis Gasca session, and then a Nat Adderley, Calling Out Loud, and then Walter Wanderley.
Walter Wanderley. Yeah, I remember that. That was Creed Taylor. I remember doing it.
